summary: Jupiter in the lagna is classically one of the best placements: a dignified, learned, long-lived and fortunate person, with directional strength and protective power over the whole chart.
common_outcomes: Handsome or dignified appearance (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.50; Jataka Parijata 8.58)
Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.50; Jataka Parijata 8.58)
Learned (Brihat Jataka 20.7; Saravali 30.50; Bhrigu Sutras 1-6)
Optimistic, jovial, magnetic personality (Raman); wise and ethical (PanchangBodh)
rare_outcomes: Fearless, blessed with children (Phaladeepika 8.14)
Acts only after weighing consequences (Saravali 30.50)
Spends on pilgrimages (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
A 'Maharaja yoga' effect around the 16th year when exalted (Bhrigu Sutras 1-6); text detail only

by_area.personality: Magnetic, optimistic, jovial, pleasant manners (Raman); energetic, courageous and great (Saravali 30.50); wisdom and ethics (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Lawyers, professors, writers, theologians; an influential leader (Raman).
by_area.health: Gluttony and corpulence can affect health (Raman); weight gain (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Its 7th aspect supports marriage (Bhrigu Sutras commentary).
by_area.family: Happiness from children (Phaladeepika 8.14); more sons if the 5th is unafflicted (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Learned in shastras and Vedas (Bhrigu Sutras 1-6); 'blessed with the grace of God' (Bhrigu Sutras commentary).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Directional strength in the 1st (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
A strong Jupiter in a kendra wards off arishtas affecting the child (Jataka Parijata and Jataka Desamarga, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary; via summary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
With Rahu, sins committed (Raman)
Debilitated or in an enemy or malefic sign: unstable mind, vanity, ingratitude, fewer children (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6)
lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: very good for Sagittarius lagna (lagna and 4th lord), Pisces lagna (lagna and 10th lord) and Cancer lagna (exalted 9th lord). PanchangBodh: for Gemini and Virgo lagnas it carries kendradhipati dosha.

by_area.relationships: A source of misery to enemies (Saravali 30.53); terror to enemies (Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness with mother and family (Phaladeepika 8.14); respected mother (PanchangBodh); peaceful domestic life (Raman).

disagreements: Agreement on success. Only Chamatkar Chintamani (via summary) adds unhappiness about children, which the Bhrigu Sutras commentator treats as the sole exception.
phrasing_guidance: Present as a career of trust and integrity: teaching, advising, administration. Avoid guaranteeing status; speak of reputation built on ethics.

summary: Jupiter in the 11th is a strong placement for gains: wealth, conveyances, servants and fame; Phaladeepika and Saravali add few children, and Saravali limited education.
common_outcomes: Wealthy, many gains (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.60; Jataka Parijata 8.95; Bhrigu Sutras 50-53; Raman)
Prosperous (Brihat Jataka 20.7)
Conveyances and servants (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.60)
Strong or piercing intellect, renowned (Jataka Parijata 8.95; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Few children (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.60; Raman)
Limited education (Saravali 30.60)
Five children; spends for others' good; maintains his father (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Effortless gains if joined by the Moon (Bhrigu Sutras 53)

by_area.career: Gains through education, consulting, finance, publishing or institutions (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Many gains, conveyances and servants (Saravali 30.60); income rises steadily, wishes often fulfilled later in life (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Raman); influential friends and mentors; supportive elder siblings (PanchangBodh).
by_area.family: Children: few (Phaladeepika, Saravali, Raman) versus several (Chamatkar Chintamani; Bhrigu Sutras commentary).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
With other benefics (even with malefics present): pronounced good luck (Bhrigu Sutras 52 and commentary)
With the Moon: effortless gains (Bhrigu Sutras 53)
Upachaya house where even malefics do well (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
In Cancer income flows more easily (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
In Capricorn income comes with more struggle (PanchangBodh)
Many opportunities can scatter attention (PanchangBodh)
lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Aquarius lagna (2nd and 11th lord in own sign) and Virgo lagna (exalted 4th and 7th lord) give very powerful Dhana yogas.

summary: Jupiter in the 12th is read negatively by every classic (disliked, idle, poor speech, servitude, scepticism), while modern writers reframe it as generosity, spiritual retreat and moksha.
common_outcomes: Disliked or odious (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
Idle or indolent (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
Poor or harsh speech (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
Servitude (Phaladeepika 8.16; Saravali 30.61)
rare_outcomes: A 'villain' (Brihat Jataka 20.7)
Sceptical about religion, irresolute, wandering (Jataka Parijata 8.98); derides religion but later repents and reforms (Raman)
Interested in study and mathematics, few children (Bhrigu Sutras 54-58)
Spends on good causes without praise (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Evil-minded (Jataka Parijata 8.98; Raman); generosity and release (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Hospitals, ashrams or life abroad (PanchangBodh); service to others (Phaladeepika 8.16).
by_area.finance: Poor (Bhrigu Sutras 54); loss of wealth (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary); spends on charity, education, pilgrimage and guests faster than it saves (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Lascivious life, later reformed (Raman); loose character (Bhrigu Sutras 54).
by_area.family: No or few children (Phaladeepika 8.16; Bhrigu Sutras 54).
by_area.spirituality: Spends on religious causes (Bhrigu Sutras 58); meditation, retreat, service in institutions, moksha (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
With a benefic, or in own or exaltation sign, an auspicious afterlife is promised (Bhrigu Sutras 55); read as strong spiritual merit
As lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th it can give Vipareeta Raja Yoga (Uttara Kalamrita, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary; via summary)
Pisces makes the spiritual current strong (PanchangBodh)
Satyacharya, as read by Bhattotpala (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes): a benefic in the 12th reduces expenditure
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
As lord of good houses it harms them from the 12th (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
With a malefic: adverse results (Bhrigu Sutras 56)
In Capricorn expenses need firmer boundaries (PanchangBodh)
lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: when Jupiter rules a dusthana (6th, 8th or 12th) its placement here can work as Vipareeta Raja Yoga.

disagreements: Strong split between classical and modern readings. Phaladeepika, Saravali, Brihat Jataka, Jataka Parijata, Bhrigu Sutras and Raman are negative; PanchangBodh and VedicFeed present a spiritual and generous Jupiter. Raman uniquely adds later reform. Satyacharya's general rule (benefics in the 12th curb expense) is at odds with PanchangBodh's 'spends faster than it saves'.
phrasing_guidance: Do not repeat labels like 'villain' or 'evil-minded'. Present as a generous, inward, spiritually inclined placement that needs budgeting and clear boundaries, and suits retreat, service or work abroad.
